newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P revises four Chinese banks outlook to stable.
newsitem.headline: S&P revises four Chinese banks outlook to stable.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it had revised outlooks on four Chinese financial institutions from positive to stable.
S&P revised the foreign currency outlooks on Bank of China, Bank of Communications, China International Trust and Investment Corp and the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China.
At the same time, S&P said it had affirmed its foreign currency ratings on these four companies.

The outlook revisions reflect the restructuring and internal reforms that must still take place before the four financial institutions can operate at an adequate risk level in a changing domestic environment, S&P said.
